<!-- An article with two tagged apps, each with an id: ?embed=<id> must show
     that one alone, ?embed=1 the first. The second draws an SVG
     (ojs-svg-block) rather than a Plotly chart. -->

```{ojs}
//| output: false
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```

Some prose before the first figure.

<div class="vm-app" id="wave">

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

<div class="ojs-chart-controls">

```{ojs}
viewof frequency = Inputs.range([1, 10], {step: 1, value: 3, label: "Frequency"})
```

</div>

```{ojs}
wavePlot = {
  const x = [], y = []
  for (let i = 0; i <= 200; i++) {
    x.push(i / 200)
    y.push(Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * frequency * i / 200))
  }
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.className = "plotly-box-large"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, [{x, y, showlegend: false, line: {color: chartColors.fn}}],
    VM.plotting.layout({yaxis: {range: [-1.2, 1.2]}}), VM.plotting.config())
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```

</div>

</div>

## A second figure

Prose between the figures.

<div class="vm-app" id="dots">

<div class="ojs-chart-block ojs-svg-block">

<div class="ojs-chart-controls">

```{ojs}
viewof dotCount = Inputs.range([1, 50], {step: 1, value: 20, label: "Dots"})
```

</div>

```{ojs}
{
  const points = []
  for (let i = 0; i < dotCount; i++) points.push([i, Math.sin(i)])
  return Plot.plot(VM.plotting.plotOptions({
    height: 300,
    marks: [Plot.dot(points, {fill: chartColors.alt})]
  }))
}
```

</div>

</div>

Prose after the last figure.
